rules.name: Minimum edge vs. fair price
rules.note: Only bet when the blended fair price beats the offered price by this much.

rules.name: Max bets per player per night
Max bets per night (best edges first)
Skip players with under 8 games this season
rules.note: Rotations and roles are unsettled in the first weeks.

rules.name: Fade rebound overs for bigs on a back-to-back
rules.note: Big men lose minutes and energy on the second night.

rules.name: Prefer props on role players (under 15 ppg)
rules.note: Books price stars carefully and role players loosely.

rules.name: Prefer overs when minutes are trending up 15%+
rules.note: Books are slow to move lines after a role change. min_trend is shrunk halfway, so 1.075 = a 15% raw rise.

rules.name: Avoid bets where our projection disagrees with the market side
rules.note: If the market edge says Over but our own projection leans Under, skip.
